why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to "Tall Timber Retreat" a sophisticated WaterColor escape professionally curated and managed by Stay on 30A. This beautifully designed four-bedroom retreat offers a seamless blend of refined coastal elegance, modern comfort, and the relaxed charm that defines life along 30A. Thoughtfully curated with warm finishes, abundant natural light, and inviting gathering spaces,  Tall Timber Retreat  is designed for effortless vacation living. Inside, the open-concept layout encourages connection and ease. The chef-inspired kitchen anchors the home, flowing naturally into the dining area and spacious living room, perfect for preparing meals together, lingering over family dinners, or unwinding after a sun-filled day exploring the coast. Each space has been intentionally designed to feel elevated yet welcoming, creating a true sense of home from the moment you arrive. Outdoors, your private pool and expansive porches invite you to slow down and savor the setting. Enjoy quiet mornings poolside, refreshing afternoon swims, or evenings spent lounging beneath the glow of coastal sunsets. Ideally located near Camp WaterColor and just minutes from the Beach Club, you’ll enjoy access to resort-style pools, private beach pathways, scenic trails, and some of the best dining and shopping along 30A. With six adult bikes and a complimentary golf cart, exploring WaterColor and cruising into nearby Seaside is both effortless and enjoyable. Whether your days are filled with poolside relaxation or Gulf-front adventure,  Tall Timber Retreat  offers a thoughtfully curated luxury experience designed for making lasting memories. Your elevated WaterColor getaway begins here.

HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -WaterColor Beach Club & Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 12) -Private Pool **Pool heating available for an additional daily fee/$25** -Poolside Sun Loungers -Outdoor Gas Grill -Golf Cart -6 Adult Bikes -Expansive Front Porch & Back Patio -Fully Equipped Gourmet Kitchen -Smart TVs -Full Sized Washer & Dryer -Beach Essential -Large Green Space In Front of Home (Perfect for the kids) -3 Minute Walk to Camp WaterColor -6 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access -Pickle Ball & Tennis Courts -Short Walk to Seaside (Restaurants, Coffee Shops, Ice Cream, Wine + Cheese, Etc.) -Close to Grayton state Park & Access to the Coastal Dune Lakes (Great for Kayaking & Yolo Boarding) -Close Access to Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining -Easy Access to Parks & Walking Paths -Nearby State Parks & Preserves -Parking for 3 Vehicles ACCOMMODATIONS: Tall Timber Retreat Sleeps: 10 FIRST FLOOR: Bedroom #1: King with Ensuite SECOND FLOOR:  Bedroom #2: Queen with Ensuite Bedroom #3: (2) Twin/Twin Bunks with Ensuite  Bedroom #4: Queen with Ensuite PRIVATE BEACH & RESORT ACCESS -The WaterColor Beach Club is the only beachfront clubhouse pool available to rental guests along 30A. It is the ultimate amenity with three pools, expanded seating on upper and lower decks, and lounge areas. The Beach Club has several food and beverage options onsite, towel service, and a charming mercantile with sundries for your pool day. With unobstructed and panoramic views of the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico, relaxation and pleasure await you at the Beach Club. Visit the WaterColor Beach Club page for facility hours, lounge chair etiquette, restaurant information, and rules. Wristbands must be worn by guests ages 5 and older. You can access the beach by walking through the Beach Club, and for those who want to sit on the sand, you can set up chairs and umbrellas behind the reserved chair area, or rent your own chairs and umbrellas from the rental shack.  NEARBY  PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS -Ray's Multi Mountain Beach Access: Is in the heart of Grayton Beach in "New Grayton", just to the west of the main Grayton Beach drive-on access at Hotz Avenue and the main "Grayton Dunes" access behind The Red Bar. -Grayton Dunes Beach Access: Access is ADA accessible, has freshwater showers, and parking on the street. Located at the end of Garfield Street behind the Red Bar in the heart of Grayton Beach. The boardwalk also extends to the end of Banfill Street one block to the east. The access is next to Western Lake outfall and Grayton Beach State Park. The freshwater lake opens periodically and exchanges water with the gulf. Several fishing charters launch off the beach for half-day and full-day trips. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Three parking spaces available (3 driveway). No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. GUEST ACCESS The WaterColor community is the most desirable community on 30A due to its exceptional community amenities. Guests will have inclusive access to the gulf-front WaterColor Beach Club and new Camp WaterColor facilities, in addition to other beautiful swimming pools located throughout the community. The WaterColor Beach Club features a huge main pool and lounge area, an adults only pool, additional pool deck with even more lounge seating, and third pool area with zero-entry (perfect for even the littlest kids!). It also has dining service available, and a sunset bar, Costa Chica. All of these amenities have beautiful views of the Gulf! Camp WaterColor is geared towards kids and has its main butterfly pool with monarch slide for older kids, caterpillar pool (zero-entry + children's area with skipper slide for younger kids), lazy lizard pool (zero-entry + lazy river), lifeguards on duty, The Canteen restaurant + bar, basketball court, playing field, and playground. OTHER THINGS TO NOTE Beach chairs through WaterColor Beach Club should be reserved in advance. Per Watercolor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands max.  In order to receive the proper number of amenity wristbands, you must enter the total number of people in your group upon booking, which you will receive a prompted email prior to your arrival. The HOA will not be able to provide additional wristbands once you are here. The WaterColor HOA will charge $50 per wristband to replace any that are lost. Watercolor requires guest contact information for Watercolor wristband registration a minimum of 1 week prior to arrival. Regarding the WaterColor pools, until water temperatures are consistently warm enough on their own, WaterColor's pools are maintained around 82 degrees. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *This home is allotted 10 wristbands max per HOA. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.  *No parties or events. *No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $25/day. Must be heated for duration of stay.  If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. *This home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".
